'''Hester Biosciences Limited''' (HBL) is a publicly traded Indian [[Animal vaccination|animal and poultry vaccines]] manufacturing company, headquartered in [[Ahmedabad]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/hester-biosciences-q2-net-up-48/article9951376.ece|title=Hester Biosciences Q2 net up 48%|date=9 November 2017 |publisher=}}</ref> Hester has plants situated in [[Gujarat]] and [[Nepal]]. Hester has a 30% share of the poultry [[vaccine]]s market in India,<ref>{{cite web|title=Hester Company Profile|url=http://www.hester.in/company-profile/|website=Hester.in|access-date=14 January 2017|archive-date=18 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170118042655/http://www.hester.in/company-profile/|url-status=dead}}</ref> making it the country's second largest poultry vaccine manufacturer. Hester is also the first commercial manufacturer of [[Orf (disease)|goat pox]] vaccine in India and manufactures [[PPR virus|PPR]] vaccines from both, Nigerian and Sungri strains.

== Finances ==
Hester equity shares are listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) as HESTERBIO and on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] (Security Code: 524669).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=HESTERBIO|title=NSE - National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.|website=nseindia.com}}</ref> They are also the owners of subsidiaries including Hester Biosciences Africa,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/hester-biosciences-gets-board-nod-to-set-up-3-million-animal-vaccine-plant-in-africa-2300427.html|title=Hester Biosciences gets board nod to set up $3 million animal vaccine plant in Africa|website=Moneycontrol}}</ref> and have acquired other company's like Gujarat Agrofarm (which they purchased in 2007).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vccircle.com/ahmedabad-based-hester-biosciences-acquires-gujarat-agrofarm/|title=Ahmedabad-based Hester Biosciences acquires Gujarat Agrofarm|date=21 November 2014|publisher=}}</ref>  As on 31 March 2019, market capitalisation of the company stood at Rs. 13.1 billion.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/india/stockpricequote/pharmaceuticals/hesterbiosciences/HB01|title=Hester Biosciences Share Price Live, Hester Biosciences Stock Price Today|website=Moneycontrol}}</ref> The CEO and founder of the company is Rajiv Gandhi.<ref name=Pilla>{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/hester-biosciences-plans-to-raise-fresh-funds-for-its-proposed-african-animal-vaccine-plant-2467463.html|title=Hester Biosciences plans to raise fresh funds for its proposed African animal vaccine plant|website=Moneycontrol}}</ref>
For the Q1FY20 ended June 2019, Hester Biosciences registers 11% sales growth in Q1FY20; Nepal unit registers 64% revenue growth, construction of Africa unit underway.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.deshgujarat.com/2019/07/31/gujarat-headquartered-hester-biosciences-registers-11-sales-growth-in-q1fy20-nepal-unit-registers-64-revenue-growth-construction-of-africa-unit-underway|title=Hester Biosciences registers 11% sales growth in Q1FY20|date=31 July 2019}}</ref>

== Operations ==
Hester creates products including vaccines, drugs, feed supplements and disinfectants.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/finance/stocks/companyProfile/HEST.BO|title=${Instrument_CompanyName} ${Instrument_Ric} Company Profile - Reuters.com|first=Reuters|last=Editorial|website=U.S.}}</ref> They have a line of 45 poultry vaccines (live and inactivated), 4 large animal vaccines (live and inactivated), health products and diagnostics.<ref name=Bhatnagar>{{cite web|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/opinion/how-hester-biosciences-became-second-largest-poultry-vaccine-manufacture-ceo-and-md-rajiv-gandhi-explains/742073/|title=How Hester Biosciences became second largest poultry vaccine manufacture: CEO and MD Rajiv Gandhi explains|date=30 June 2017|publisher=}}</ref> Hester also provides seromonitoring for poultry farms and mastitis prevention programmers for cattle farms.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://markets.ft.com/data/equities/tearsheet/profile?s=HESTERBIOOL:NSI|title=Hester Biosciences Ltd, HESTERBIOOL:NSI profile - FT.com|website=markets.ft.com}}</ref> The company owns and operates Asia's largest single-location animal biological manufacturing facility.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/rajiv-gandhi-ceo-md-hester-biosciences-ltd-115041300221_1.html|title=Rajiv Gandhi, CEO & MD, Hester Biosciences Ltd|last=indiainfoline.com|publisher=}}</ref> Hester Biosciences also has an R&D unit at Kadi,<ref name=Bhatnagar /> and develops new animal vaccines,<ref name=Pilla /> an example of which is the Goat Pox vaccine Live-Uttarkashi strain used in India.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/hester-biosciences-surges-10-on-launching-ppr-and-goat-pox-vaccine-115031900166_1.html|title=Hester Biosciences surges 10% on launching PPR and goat pox vaccine|first=S. I.|last=Reporter|newspaper=Business Standard India|date=19 March 2015|publisher=|via=Business Standard}}</ref> They have also partnered with Galvmed on vaccines for Newcastle disease.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://deshgujarat.com/2017/12/09/gujarat-based-hester-finds-mention-in-bill-gates-speech/|title=Gujarat based Hester finds mention in Bill Gates speech|date=9 December 2017|publisher=}}</ref>

The company is planning to increase its exports to the African region following good market potential and the need for animal vaccines in that region. Hester expects export revenues from Africa to increase to about 70 percent in the coming years from 40 to 45 percent currently. In the first nine months of the current fiscal, Hester's overall exports stood at Rs 12 crore, with Africa's share at 40-45 percent. Hester targets African market for poultry, animal healthcare products<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/hester-targets-african-market-for-poultry-animal-healthcare-products/article26128149.ece|title=Hester targets African market for poultry, animal healthcare products|date=30 January 2019 }}</ref>

In 2026, [[Ravin Gandhi]] resigned from the board of Hester, citing professional and personal commitments that prevent him from devoting sufficient time to company affairs.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/hester-biosciences-non-executive-director-ravin-gandhi-resigns-alternate-director-role-ends|title=Hester Biosciences Non-Executive Director Ravin Gandhi Resigns, Alternate Director Role Ends|date=12 May 2026|publisher=TipRanks}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
In 2010 Hester Biosciences received "The Best Animal Vaccine Company" honor from ''The New Economy'' in the UK.<ref>{{cite web|title=India biosciences ready to fly|url=http://www.theneweconomy.com/technology/indias-biosciences-ready-to-fly|website=The New Economy, UK}}</ref>
